Title: Login in with valid credentials
Test Steps:
1. Enter 'standard_user' in Username
2. Enter 'secret_sauce' in Password
3. Click 'Login' button
Expected Result:
User is logged in successfully 
and redirected to /inventory.html.
Actual Result:
Redirected to inventory page
 with item list displayed.

Title: Add Single Item to Cart
Pre-conditions:
User is logged in and 
on the inventory page
Test Steps:
1. Locate 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
2. Click 'Add to cart' button
Expected Result:
Button text changes to 'Remove'
 and shopping cart badge increments to '1'.
Actual Result:
Badge updated to 1; 
button updated to 'Remove'.

Title:
Complete End-to-End 
Checkout
Pre-conditions: At least 1 item is in the cart
Test Steps:
1. Click Cart icon
2. Click 'Checkout'
3. Enter First Name, Last Name, Zip Code
4. Click 'Continue'
5. Click 'Finish'
Expected Result:
Redirected to /checkout-complete.html 
displaying 'Thank you for your order!'
Actual Result:
Order completed successfully
 with confirmation message displayed.

Title: Remove Item from Cart
Pre-conditions: Sauce Labs Backpack' is in the cart
Expected Result:
Button changes back to
 'Add to cart' and cart count badge disappears/decrements.
Actual Result:
Badge removed; button reset to
 'Add to cart'.

Title:
Sort Products by Price
 (Low to High)
Pre-conditions:
User is logged in and on
 the inventory page
Test Steps:
1. Click product sort dropdown
2. Select 'Price (low to high)'
Expected Result:
Products rearrange in ascending 
order starting with $7.99 item.
Actual Result:
Products sorted correctly by
 lowest price first.

Expected Result:
Error displayed: 'Epic sadface:
 Username and password do not match...'

Title: Login with Locked Out User
Expected Result:
Error displayed: 'Epic sadface:
 Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

Title:
Submit Checkout with Blank 
Fields
Pre-conditions:
Item added to cart and user is on
 /checkout-step-one.html
Test Steps:
1. Leave First Name, Last Name, Zip blank
2. Click 'Continue'
Expected Result:
Navigation blocked; error displayed:
 'Error: First Name is required'
Actual Result:
Form submission prevented with
 proper error banner.

Title:
Direct Page Access 
Without Authentication
Pre-conditions:
Browser is open with 
clear cache/session
Expected Result:
Page access blocked;
 redirected to login with auth error banner.
Actual Result:
Redirected back to / with missing
 login error.

Title:
Submit Checkout with
 Missing Postal Code
Pre-conditions:
Item in cart and user on 
checkout step one
Test Steps:
1. Enter First Name 'John'
2. Enter Last Name 'Doe'
3. Leave Zip Code empty
4. Click 'Continue'
Expected Result:
Navigation blocked; error displayed: 
'Error: Postal Code is required'.
Actual Result:
System blocked progression and 
displayed Postal Code error.

Title:
Maximum Input Length in
 Checkout Fields
Pre-conditions:
Item in cart and user on 
/checkout-step-one.html
Test Steps:
1. Enter 250+ characters in First Name, Last Name, and Postal Code
2. Click 'Continue'
Expected Result:
Inputs handle long strings safely
 without UI overflow or application 
crashes.
Actual Result:
Input trimmed/accepted safely 
without application errors.

Title:
Rapid Multi-Clicks 
on Order Finish Button
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Finish' button rapidly
 multiple times in quick succession
Expected Result:
Only one order is submitted; 
system prevents duplicate API/order transactions.
Actual Result:
Order processed once without 
duplicate submission bugs.

Title:
Mid-Checkout Navigation
 Back Button
Test Steps:
1. Click browser 'Back' button 
to return to step one
Expected Result:
Checkout state persists gracefully 
or prompts user cleanly without
 crashing session.
Actual Result:
Returned to step one cleanly; 
state preserved.

Title:
Cart Badge Limit with All 
Items Added
Pre-conditions:
User is on inventory page with 
empty cart
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Add to cart' on all 6 available 
items on the page sequentially
Expected Result:
Cart badge updates to exactly '6'
 without rendering overflow/layout distortion.
Actual Result:
Badge counter scales to 6 with 
intact UI layout.

Title:
Special Characters in 
Field Inputs
Test Steps:
1. Enter '<script>alert(1)</script>' in Username
2. Enter "' OR '1'='1" in Password
3. Click 'Login'
Expected Result:
Input is sanitized; standard invalid 
login error is displayed without 
script execution.
